rows.label: fev05_150_125_msg0001
rows.name:
Rex-sama, how was it returning
to your hometown after so long?

rows.label: fev05_150_125_msg0002
rows.name:
The kids had grown, but the village
hadn't changed much. It made me
nostalgic.

rows.label: fev05_150_125_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm totally rested and
ready to go! I'll lead you
all the way to the port!

rows.label: fev05_150_125_msg0005
rows.name:
Though to be honest... the port is
actually on the next island over.

rows.label: fev05_150_125_msg0006
rows.name: It's not far, so let's get going.
